fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
Solar leads, qualified one tap at a time

Brightway Solar's Facebook ad opens a qualifier with four questions, a question per screen, each answered by tapping a large button. Only the ZIP code step opens the number pad. Homeowners are saved as leads, and a sales rep calls each one by 9 AM the next day. Renters see a page about community solar.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
Pickup windows that close at 25 orders

Every Thursday at noon, Fern and Field Florist texts subscribers a link to its weekend bouquet. Saturday pickup windows show as large buttons, with payment at the counter. Each window holds 25 orders and drops off the page once full. This week the 10 AM window closed first, and the prep list shows 76 bouquets.
fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
How the demo page restacks on a phone

On a laptop, Fieldnote's demo page shows its plans for inspection teams side by side in a pricing table. On a handset the plans stack as cards, and the demo form moves up under the headline. Each request is saved with the device it came from. Phones sent 94 of last month's 162 demo requests.
